_comment: Coded-concept ROWS for the `lung_nodule` capability (MOS-IMG-111, MOS-REG-042).
THIS FILE IS DATA, NOT CODE. It is the `capability_concepts` rows a platform curator
inserts when the Capability is registered. MOS-IMG-113 forbids materialising a
clinical code list in Python as a table, a constant map or an enum, so every code
`medos/services/lung_nodule` emits is resolved out of here at run time and a missing key
RAISES (MOS-IMG-112: 'the writer MUST raise rather than invent a code').
WHY AN OVERLAY AND NOT A SECOND DICTIONARY. `medos.core.concepts.ConceptDictionary`
loads ONE json file and `MEDOS_CAPABILITY_CONCEPTS` REPLACES the path wholesale --
there is no additive registration path, because the `capability_concepts` TABLE
MOS-IMG-111 names does not exist in this build and its stand-in is a file. Committing
a full copy of the base dictionary here would create exactly the second definition
CONTRACT.md section 2 exists to eliminate, and the two would drift on the first added
code. So this file carries ONLY the new rows and
`services.lung_nodule.concepts.compose()` merges it onto the base at deploy time,
refusing to redefine any key the base already owns. REPORTED as a platform gap, not
patched: see this component's report.
CODE VALUES LONGER THAN 16 CHARACTERS. `NODULE_CANDIDATE_COUNT` (22) and
`NODULE_EQUIV_DIAMETER` (21) exceed the SH limit DICOM PS3.3 puts on `CodeValue`, so a
conformant writer -- highdicom, here -- carries them in `LongCodeValue` (UC) and omits
`CodeValue` entirely. VERIFIED on a written SR, not assumed.
The consequence is worth knowing before it bites someone: a consumer that reads only
`CodeValue` silently drops exactly these two measurements, i.e. precisely the
non-standard ones a 99MEDOS code exists to make visible. The names are kept long
anyway, because the platform's own `param.operating_threshold`
(`OPERATING_THRESHOLD`, 19 characters) already sets that house style and a second,
shorter convention here would be worse than one consistent one. The SR-side assertion
in tests/integration/test_lung_nodule.py reads all three spellings.

_note: SNOMED CT morphologic-abnormality concept. It is the SegmentedPropertyType of
the SEG this capability produces, paired with category `category.abnormal`
(SCT:49755003 Morphologically Abnormal Structure) and anatomic region
`anatomy.lung` -- the triple DICOM PS3.16 TID 1411 expects for a lesion segment.
A MORPHOLOGY AND DELIBERATELY NOT A DIAGNOSIS. It describes the shape of what was
outlined; it does not assert that the patient has a pulmonary nodule. The
diagnostic claim would be a clinical assertion that a Hounsfield threshold is in

private_code_rationale: This is the SR finding type, and no standard code says what is true here. SNOMED
CT 427359005 'Solitary nodule of lung' and RadLex RID3875 'nodule' both assert a
FINDING -- that a nodule is present. This capability is a threshold-and-connected
component detector with no clinical validation of any kind (see
METADATA.not_validated_for in medos/services/lung_nodule/service.py), so emitting
either of them would put a coded clinical assertion nobody made into a DICOM SR
that outlives the run.
The private code carries the disclaimer INSIDE the code meaning, where a viewer
that renders the SR without reading our metadata still shows it. Promotion to a
standard code is forbidden until this capability has a ValidationReport meeting
an AcceptanceCriteria; review each minor release (MOS-IMG-114).
SNOMED CT, RadLex, DCM and LOINC were searched 2026-09 for a term expressing
'count of algorithm-detected candidate lesions'. The candidates are a property of
THIS algorithm's output at THIS parameter set, not a clinical quantity: the same
study yields a different count under a different HU threshold, which is why the
threshold travels with the number in METADATA.parameters. A standard code would
imply a study-level clinical count that is reproducible across methods, and it
is not. Review each minor release (MOS-IMG-114).
UCUM '1' is the unity/dimensionless unit; MOS-REG-044 requires every measurement
to carry a non-empty UCUM unit, and a count has no other honest one.

quantity.nodule_equivalent_diameter.code_meaning: Equivalent spherical diameter of a detected candidate
private_code_rationale: NOT a standard lesion-axis code, and the distinction is clinical, not cosmetic.
DICOM PS3.16 TID 1500 measurement groups code a LONG AXIS -- the longest calliper
a reader draws through the lesion, which is what Fleischner and Lung-RADS
thresholds are defined against. This number is something else: the diameter of
the sphere with the same VOLUME as the connected component,
d = (6V/pi)^(1/3). For a non-spherical lesion the two disagree, and the
equivalent diameter is systematically SMALLER than the long axis.
Emitting this under a long-axis code would place it directly into a Fleischner
size band it was not measured for. A private code with the method in the code
meaning cannot be size-banded by accident. Review each minor release
(MOS-IMG-114).

lung_nodule.label: Nodule candidate (HU threshold)
_note: One profile, therefore ONE SEG segment carrying the union of every accepted
candidate. Not one segment per candidate: `medos.writer.identity` indexes
segments by their profile slug (`{s.structure: ... for s in segments}`), so N
segments sharing this slug would collapse to one entry and silently lose every
candidate's measurements but the last. Per-candidate numbers ride as their own
The SEG label is 31 characters; DICOM SegmentLabel allows 64.
